label: S2 shown at D2, early in the episode (rare a1->S2 strongest, lasts longer)
explanation: Fires almost only at D2 (98.6% of mass) when the reached state shown is S2 (96% of mass; S1 is shown in only 2.4%). It never fires at D1 and almost never at GO. It depends strongly on how far into the episode the agent is: the rate is 56% on trial 0 and falls steadily, and it is silent from about trial 40 on. That looks like a slow drift in the hidden state across the episode. The strongest activations (max) are rare transitions a1->S2 (S2 reached after choosing a1), and these keep firing later in the episode (up to about trial 35) than common a2->S2 does (up to about 20). Within early S2 D2 steps, which are hit is also modulated by the higher value bins, but that did not help as a predicate. Plain (D2 & S2) has recall 0.94 but precision 0.15, so the episode-time gate is essential. All variables are observed: the state input, the action input and the trial index, which the agent can only track implicitly. Reward and other future variables play no role.

issues: The factual claims check out on dev. Activation mass by phase is D1 0, GO 1.4%, D2 98.6%. S2 holds 96.2% of the mass. The ep_bucket 0 rate is 0.556. Nothing fires at ep_trial 50 or later, and only 23 steps fire in trials 40-49. Test scores reproduce exactly: P 0.746, R 0.902, F1 0.817, MR 0.955.
The a1->S2 vs a2->S2 claim holds. D2&S2&a1 has precision 1.00 up to trial 20, 0.93 at trials 20-24, 0.62 at 25-29 and 0.31 at 30-34. D2&S2&a2 is at 0.89-0.94 early and decays sooner.

There is a systematic gap: the previous trial's outcome (an observed input, the reward shown at D1) controls how long common a2->S2 keeps firing. Within D2&S2&a2 at ep_trial 15-29, precision is 0.39 when prev_reward==0 but only 0.04 when prev_reward==1. At ep_trial 10-19, a2->S2 has precision 0.83 after an unrewarded trial vs 0.46 after a rewarded one. At ep_trial 20-29 it is 0.20 vs 0.00.

Most false positives of the original predicate sit in one block: a2->S2 after a rewarded trial at ep_trial 15-19 (precision 0.12, about 5000 predicted steps). The misses output shows the same pattern: in runs of rewarded a2->S2c trials, activation falls to zero within the same window.
Minor and not systematic enough to matter: D2&S1 fires very early in the episode (precision 0.29 at ep_trial < 5, 2.4% of the mass). GO firing is real but small (520 steps, 1.4% of the mass).
skeptic.revised_label: S2 shown at D2 early in the episode. Rare a1->S2 fires until about trial 30. Common a2->S2 fires until about trial 22 if the previous trial was unrewarded, but only until about trial 15 if it was rewarded.
